name: com.rezabehjat.capture
description: Stream Deck+ plugin: an interface to Capture (lighting visualizer)

scripts.test: npm run gen && npm run build && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 test/osc.test.ts test/properties.test.ts test/applescript.test.ts test/menu.test.ts test/timing.test.ts test/stub.test.ts test/ax.test.ts test/axkeys.test.ts test/render.test.ts test/catalog.test.ts test/manifest.test.ts test/queue.test.ts test/worker.test.ts test/worker-script.test.ts test/menucache.test.ts test/resolve.test.ts test/profile.test.ts test/fixtures.test.ts test/integration.test.ts test/integration-worker.test.ts test/integration-fixtures.test.ts
scripts.pack: npm run gen && npm run build && streamdeck validate com.rezabehjat.capture.sdPlugin && streamdeck pack com.rezabehjat.capture.sdPlugin --output dist --force
scripts.test:unit: node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 test/osc.test.ts test/properties.test.ts test/applescript.test.ts test/menu.test.ts test/timing.test.ts test/stub.test.ts test/ax.test.ts test/axkeys.test.ts test/render.test.ts test/catalog.test.ts test/manifest.test.ts test/queue.test.ts test/worker.test.ts test/worker-script.test.ts test/menucache.test.ts test/resolve.test.ts test/profile.test.ts test/fixtures.test.ts
scripts.gen: node --import tsx scripts/gen-manifest.mjs && node --import tsx scripts/gen-ui-data.mjs
